control.title: Cyber Crisis Management Plan
control.description: Keep a Board-approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan covering detection, containment, response and recovery for cyber scenarios, aligned with CERT-In guidance, tested through drills or tabletop exercises at least yearly.

evidence_hint: Approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan, drill or tabletop report with lessons.
acceptance_criteria: A Cyber Crisis Management Plan approved by the Board or its committee within the last 12 months
It covers detection, containment, response, recovery and communication for named scenarios
A drill or tabletop exercise was run in the last 12 months with lessons recorded

criteria_coverage.criterion: A Cyber Crisis Management Plan approved by the Board or its committee within the last 12 months

requirements.title: Board-approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan
requirements.guidance: A separate Cyber Crisis Management Plan, referring to CERT-In, NCIIPC and IDRBT guidance.
